title: Handley Page Hampden AD854
memorial_details: Plaque with dedicatory inscription attached to a Public Footpath sign.
inscription: As you walk along this path, you will pass/ a point on your left some 200 yeards further on,/ where during WW2, in the early hours of/ 9th September 1941, a British Bomber crashed/ in flames killing Sgt Ford Rowney aged 23 &/ Flight Sgt Tony Barker aged 20. The other two members of the crew, Sgt L Morgan &/ Sgt J Mitchell survived by bailing-out and/ landed close to this spot./ As you pass by, please remember these two/ young airmen, who paid the ultimate sacrifice/ for their country and our future.
original_title: Sergeant F Rowney and Flight Sergeant T Barker and Handley Page Hampden AD854
